name: Old-Spice absurd spokesman
tagline: The high-key, oiled-chest, mouth-open, impossible-match-cut spokesman register — bright pastel commercial light, deliberate-prop fake creatures, and a distinct physical beat between every start and end frame.
description: How to prompt image and i2v models for an Old-Spice / absurd-swagger spokesman ad (Terry-Crews / Isaiah-Mustafa vibe). Covers the bright high-key pastel commercial register (the OPPOSITE of moody luxury-fragrance chiaroscuro), the oiled-chest + mouth-open + direct-camera-wide-eyes actor language, the five tells that make a comedic prop read as an intentional fake rather than an AI failure, and the start-vs-end-frame motion-delta rule that keeps i2v clips from rendering as static stills.
